name: sys-info
description: Host resource snapshot: CPU model/cores/load, memory (incl. cgroup container limits), disk free, GPU (nvidia-smi or DRM), battery/AC, network byte counters, hostname/uptime. Missing data degrades to null; never fails the whole call.
use_when: choosing context sizes, local-model backends, or checking headroom before heavy work
stdout: JSON {cpu, mem, disk, gpu, power, net, meta} — sizes in bytes, load as [1m,5m,15m].
notes: Linux-first (/proc, /sys, cgroup v2). nvidia-smi used when present; otherwise counts DRM devices.
